title: Billing cycles and invoices
text: Meridian bills monthly on the calendar day you subscribed. The invoice is generated at 00:00 UTC on that billing day and emailed to the workspace billing contact. Annual plans are billed once for twelve months upfront and receive a 15 percent discount against the monthly rate.

title: Changing your plan mid-cycle
text: Upgrades take effect immediately and you are charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the current billing period. Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle, and no partial refund is issued for the unused portion of the current one.

title: Payment methods and failed payments
text: Payment methods are managed under Settings, Billing, Payment methods. If a charge is declined, Meridian retries the payment three times over seven days and emails the billing contact after each attempt. If all three retries fail, the workspace is set to read-only until a valid payment method is added. Data is retained for 30 days after a workspace goes read-only.

title: API rate limits by plan
text: The Free plan allows 60 requests per minute, the Team plan allows 600 requests per minute, and the Enterprise plan allows 6000 requests per minute. Limits apply per workspace rather than per API key, and are measured over a sliding 60 second window.

title: Handling 429 responses
text: A 429 response includes a Retry-After header giving the number of seconds to wait before retrying. Clients should retry with exponential backoff rather than a fixed interval. Every API response also carries X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers so a client can slow down before hitting the ceiling. Bulk endpoints count as ten requests against your limit rather than one.

title: Inviting your team
text: Invite teammates from Settings, Members, Invite. An invitation email is valid for 14 days, after which it expires and must be resent. Available roles are Viewer, Editor, and Admin. The Free plan is capped at 3 members per workspace.

title: Connecting your first data source
text: New workspaces start empty. Connect a data source from Settings, Sources. Meridian supports Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake, and CSV upload. The first sync runs immediately and subsequent syncs run hourly by default, configurable down to every 5 minutes on Team and Enterprise plans.

title: Refund policy and cancellations
text: If you cancel within 14 days of your first paid invoice, you get your money back in full. Annual plans are eligible for a prorated refund within 30 days of purchase. Monthly renewals are not refundable after 14 days have passed, so a cancellation later in the subscription ends billing at the next cycle without returning the current period. Refunds are not available for usage-based overage charges.

title: Requesting a refund
text: To request a refund, email billing@meridian.example from the billing contact address with the invoice number. Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days and returned to the original payment method. Refunds cannot be issued as account credit.

title: SAML SSO availability
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan only. Meridian supports Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, and any generic SAML 2.0 identity provider. SSO is configured under Settings, Security, Single sign-on by a workspace Admin.

title: Enforcing SSO and SCIM provisioning
text: Once SAML SSO is configured, an Admin can enforce it for the whole workspace, which disables password login for every member except break-glass Admin accounts. SCIM user provisioning and deprovisioning is available alongside enforced SSO on the Enterprise plan.

title: Creating and rotating API keys
text: Workspace API keys are created under Settings, Developers, API keys. Live keys are prefixed mdn_live_ and test keys are prefixed mdn_test_. A key can be rotated in place: the old secret remains valid for 24 hours after rotation so clients can cut over. Keys inherit the workspace rate limit rather than carrying a separate quota, and they cannot be used to change billing settings.
